title: 第3章 未知的邪恶生物第4章 剧情任务触发了
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
林间小道之上，小姑娘布兰妮脚步轻快，还真就是一派天真烂漫的小女孩模样。
李凯南跟在她的身后，下意识打量着四周。
此时两人已经越发远离了那处祥和的村子，两旁的森林越发茂密幽深起来。
而且四周密林深处更是隐隐给人一种阴冷惊悚，后背发凉的感觉！
一个老太太独自居住在这远离村庄的地方，家里人还放心布兰妮这么个小姑娘独自前来探望？
嗯，这很不合理。
但如果是剧情任务的触发cg，那就很合理了……
而也就是在这个时候，李凯南忽然眉头一皱，眼神锐利地看向道路两旁的密林之中。
他没有察觉到什么异动，但直觉却告诉他有些不对劲，好像有一道充满了恶意的视线在盯着自己……
事实上，李凯南的直觉并没有出错！
布兰妮身上穿着的那件天鹅绒红斗篷，此时忽然闪烁起一道红光来。
红光并不耀眼刺目，反倒是像初生阳光一般带着温暖的感觉。
虽然只是一闪而过，却也给道路两旁那幽暗死寂的密林之中带来一丝光亮！
下一刻，隐藏其中的邪恶视线被红光所惊扰。
密林之中忽然草木摇曳，更有快速的脚步声，就好像是有什么东西正在仓皇逃开。
李凯南眼神一厉，那几乎本能的战斗直觉被触发了。
他直接抽出腰间那柄穿越时一同带来、还没有开锋的华丽骑士剑，臂膀骤然发力，猛地朝前方密林中掷去。
长剑带着呼啸的风声向前飞掷，空气被撕裂的赫赫声刺耳至极。
重物撞击的轰响之声传来，前方密林之中传来了一阵极度痛苦的惨烈哀嚎之声。
那也不知道是什么玩意的东西压抑着痛苦闷哼一声，然后密林中细微迅捷的脚步声居然再度响起。

居然还能跑了？
小姑娘布兰妮浑然不知刚刚密林中有东西盯上了他们，也没有发觉自己身上红色斗篷刚刚亮起的神奇红光。
她反倒是被李凯南忽然掷出配剑的举动给吓了一跳，一边拍着自己连颤不停的胸口，一边问道：
“凯南大人，发生了什么事情？”
“刚刚不知道是什么东西躲在森林里，似乎是想要袭击我们……”
李凯南回答着布兰妮的问题，然后快步走进了旁边密林之中。
他带着的那柄华丽骑士剑，显然并非简单样子货。
而是他运用现代工艺所锻造，一柄剑都要几万块的那种高档货！
放在古代，绝对是绝代神兵。
虽然还尚未开锋，但如今的李凯南堪比人型机械，单手也有数吨的力量，佩剑被掷出之后的杀伤力恐怖无比！
密林之中，李凯南便看到自己的骑士剑此时已经深深插进了一棵巨树的树干中。
华丽的剑身之上，此时还串着一只长满了灰色长毛的粗壮手臂，上面还在滴着发黑腥臭的污血！
打量了一下这并不光滑的手臂断裂伤口，李凯南眉头皱起。
刚刚那只不知道什么玩意的生物，应该是先被他掷出的骑士剑死死钉在了树上。
content_en:
On the forest path, the little girl Britney walked briskly, she really looked like an innocent little girl.
Li Kainan followed her and looked around subconsciously.
At this time, the two of them were farther and farther away from the peaceful village, and the forests on both sides became denser and deeper.
Moreover, the depths of the surrounding dense forest give people a faint, cold and terrifying feeling, with chills on the back!
An old lady lives alone in this place far away from the village. How can the family trust that a little girl like Britney comes to visit alone?
Well, that's unreasonable.
But if it’s the cg that triggers the plot mission, it’s very reasonable...
It was at this moment that Li Kainan suddenly frowned and looked sharply into the dense forests on both sides of the road.
He didn't notice anything unusual, but his intuition told him that something was wrong, as if there was a malicious sight staring at him...
In fact, Li Kainan’s intuition was not wrong!
The velvet red cloak that Britney was wearing suddenly flashed a red light.
The red light is not dazzling, but has a warm feeling like the newborn sunshine.
Although it only flashed by, it also brought a ray of light to the dark and silent jungle on both sides of the road!
The next moment, the evil vision hidden inside was disturbed by the red light.
Suddenly the vegetation swayed in the dense forest, and there were sounds of fast footsteps, as if something was escaping in a hurry.
Li Kainan's eyes sharpened, and his almost instinctive fighting instinct was triggered.
He directly pulled out the gorgeous knight's sword that he had brought with him when he traveled and had not yet opened it. His arm suddenly exerted force and he threw it towards the dense forest ahead.
The long sword flew forward with the sound of howling wind, and the loud sound of the air being torn apart was extremely harsh.
The sound of heavy objects hitting the ground was heard, and a burst of extremely painful wails came from the dense forest ahead.
The thing that didn't know what it was suppressed a groan of pain, and then the sound of subtle and swift footsteps in the dense forest sounded again.
Can he still run?
The little girl Britney had no idea that something in the dense forest had just stared at them, nor did she notice the magical red light on her red cloak.
On the contrary, she was startled by Li Kainan's sudden move of throwing his sword. While patting her trembling chest, she asked:
"Lord Kenan, what happened?"
"I don't know what was hiding in the forest just now, it seemed to want to attack us..."
Li Kainan answered Britney's question, and then quickly walked into the dense forest nearby.
The gorgeous knight's sword he carried was obviously not a simple one.
Instead, he used modern craftsmanship to forge a high-end sword that costs tens of thousands of yuan!
In ancient times, it was definitely a peerless magic weapon.
Although he has not yet started his attack, Li Kainan is now comparable to a humanoid machine. He has tons of power in one hand. The lethality of the sword after being thrown is terrifying!
In the dense forest, Li Kainan saw that his knight's sword had been deeply inserted into the trunk of a giant tree.
On top of the gorgeous sword body, there is now a thick arm covered with long gray hair, and it is still dripping with black and smelly blood!
After taking a look at the broken arm wound, which was not smooth, Li Kainan frowned.
The unknown creature just now was probably pinned to the tree by the knight's sword he threw.
